title: build response
description: Standard output of build in JSON mode (BUILD-031 to BUILD-033; noos BUILD-520, BUILD-521). $defs/base is BuildResponse (overview 2.1).

base.description: BuildResponse: path is the artifact, when there is one.

oneOf.description: AA_BUILD succeeded and left the output file (BUILD-032): path is the .dtbo, or where output is devicetree the .dtb, with source the full devicetree build wrote first (BUILD-015).

path.description: The output file, absolute: $AA_DTBO, or $AA_DTB where output is devicetree.

source.description: Where output is devicetree: the full devicetree file, absolute.

oneOf.description: AA_BUILD succeeded but left no output file where it goes (BUILD-033).

AA_BUILD failed: 'Build failed: AA_BUILD exited with status <n>' (or 'did not run: <why>'), then a newline and its standard error when it wrote any (BUILD-031); where output is devicetree, 'Build failed: ' and why the full devicetree couldn't be written or preprocessed (BUILD-013, BUILD-014).
A problem of the workspace, among them aa_build.sh missing or not executable while AA_BUILD is its default (COM-150).

anyOf.description: Where the backend is noos: the project was built (BUILD-520). path is the ELF, when the build left one; severity is warn when it didn't (BUILD-521).
